title: OpenBill
description:
One page that tells a person what their medical care and drugs actually cost, with a source and a date on every single number.

Phase 1 covers drugs: what US pharmacies pay (CMS NADAC) beside what Medicare pays (Medicare Part D Spending by Drug, Medicare Part B payment limits), with the state, source file, effective date and retrieved date of every figure. The code is MIT-licensed; the data is derived from US government sources listed in docs/DATA_SOURCES.md.

Not medical advice. No warranty. Other people's data can be wrong.
